inspection.limitations: User automatic approval for subsequent modelling decisions applies only within the exact UVEK 2026 cut-off / ecoinvent 3.10 biosphere electricity pilot. Only the encountered ecoinvent 3.9 cut-off RoW other-than-natural-gas district/industrial heat market is qualified. Preserve all 188 original market supplier coefficients, source order and marginal uncertainty individually, without omission, aggregation or normalization. Positive source and reconstructed heat reference 1 MJ means factor +1: negative caller heat credits remain negative. There is no district consumer network, loss uplift, efficiency multiplier, co-output credit, avoided fuel or material credit. Complete native useful-heat services include their own efficiency, infrastructure, fuel, emissions, ash handling and allocation. Furnace/wood species/feedstock/capacity matches remain distinct where available. Native historical CH, national coal and ENTSO-E coal fleets proxy missing source locations; historical UCTE is used for absent oil-power locations, not an invented global oil fleet. Native geographic text/identity contradictions, vintage, efficiency, emissions and internal uncertainty remain limitations. Wood CHP 1 MWth substitutes source 6667 kW CHP and 2014 variants. LPG 50 kW condensing/modulating propane/butane heat substitutes industrial >100 kW propane. Coal-tar heat uses the complete heavy-fuel-oil furnace on which the source explicitly based its proxy, with fuel sourcing, composition, PAH/metals, allocation and emissions differences. Two straw and six pulp-mill heat entries use complete native biomass heat screening proxies; industrial wood replaces straw, and wood-chip CHP replaces pulp-mill/black-liquor recovered heat. Cultivation/organic status, ash/alkali, chemical recovery, feedstock, source coproduct versus native exergy allocation, scale and emissions differences are explicit; no source internal inventory or LCIA equivalence is asserted. For 48 gas-plant heat outputs and one coke furnace, source allocated fuel demand per heat MJ drives native per-fuel-MJ combustion; do not equate fuel MJ to heat MJ. Native blast-furnace gas excludes fuel production whereas source buys gas: retain this upstream boundary/allocation difference explicitly; native coke-oven fuel production stays included. For refinery heat, preserve audited gas mass by source kg divided by native kg per fuel MJ, retaining source reference ambiguity and native infrastructure difference without inferred thermal efficiency. For 24 bagasse/oil CHP outputs and one EAF heat output, source nonproduction coordinates are proportional to companion electricity/steel inventory; the audited ratio weights the complete native donor as an allocated-burden proxy, not physical electricity consumption or a steel purchase. Native bagasse donor includes economic agricultural/refinery/distillery allocation; source separate combustion allocation differs. Native oil fleet/CHP share, EAF steel/slag allocation, output heat quality and internal uncertainties differ. These ratios do not establish native allocation equivalence or an energy-unit conversion. Twelve exact positive source heat outputs contain production only; use the verified native positive recovered-heat output whose documented allocation is 100% to waste disposal and 0% to energy and whose inventory likewise contains production only. Retain their original heat shares with explicit waste/feedstock/technology/geography proxy warnings, not an invented zero physical combustion or empty disposal service. Six municipal recovered-heat wrappers use that same complete native recovered-heat service at plant gate; source internal regional routing, recovery and allocation are replaced, not claimed identical. No generic empty-provider fallback, zero-burden helper or omission authorization is introduced. Source producer internal formulas, parameters, exchanges and uncertainty are replaced by the specified native models; audited driver coefficients and market/caller quantities remain distinct. Native bundle pin and 2,991 upstream biosphere exclusions persist. All proxy score effects remain unquantified. Preserve caller ownership, formulas, signed uncertainty, foreground links and separate exchanges. Uninspected profiles, standalone producers, reverse or cross-system-model routes and full scenario/certification/export are outside this decision.

limitations: One positive kg of hard-coal-ash treatment service reconstructed from the original negative-one-kg market. Native Swiss municipal incineration lacks the source Swiss fly-ash extraction; warn about extraction, residue recovery, allocation and emissions differences, without adding a recovery credit. Native regional landfill processes and reviewed rail/fleet proxies carry geography, technology, vintage and internal-uncertainty limitations. Original positive freight quantities remain positive; negative-reference normalization is not a blanket sign flip of transport.

Only the individually inspected ecoinvent 3.9 cut-off identities qualify. Native utilities, coal grades, delivery, transport fleets, geography, technology, allocation, vintage, internal uncertainty and biosphere coverage are screening approximations with unquantified score effects. Preserve original production/reactivation shares, all nonempty process inputs, signed caller quantities, uncertainty, formulas, direct emissions and freight; no renormalization or recovered-material/energy credit. Exactly 51 proven empty negative-reference cut-off ash receivers are omitted from the two ash helper inventories with identity/quantity/hash audits; no nonempty receiving inventory is omitted. limitations: One positive kg of hard-coal-ash treatment service reconstructed from the original negative-one-kg market. Retain every nonempty receiving-process quantity and each freight row in source order; convert the negative waste-reference demands to positive disposal-service inputs with factor -1 and consistent uncertainty scaling. Omit only independently proven production-only zero-price cut-off receivers, retaining every source identity, signed quantity, statistics and inventory hash in the review omission audit. Do not renormalize the remaining disposal shares or add recovery credits. Preserve the source residual-landfill/sanitary-landfill/incineration split. Native Swiss municipal incineration lacks the source Swiss fly-ash extraction; warn about extraction, residue recovery, allocation and emissions differences, without adding a recovery credit. Native regional landfill processes and reviewed rail/fleet proxies carry geography, technology, vintage and internal-uncertainty limitations. Original positive freight quantities remain positive; negative-reference normalization is not a blanket sign flip of transport.

Only the individually inspected ecoinvent 3.9 cut-off identities qualify. Native utilities, coal grades, delivery, transport fleets, geography, technology, allocation, vintage, internal uncertainty and biosphere coverage are screening approximations with unquantified score effects. Preserve original production/reactivation shares, all nonempty process inputs, signed caller quantities, uncertainty, formulas, direct emissions and freight; no renormalization or recovered-material/energy credit. Exactly 51 proven empty negative-reference cut-off ash receivers are omitted from the two ash helper inventories with identity/quantity/hash audits; no nonempty receiving inventory is omitted. Source emptiness does not authorize zero-burden substitutes elsewhere. Other versions and consequential conversions are not newly approved.

inspection.basis: One positive kg of virgin granular activated carbon from hard coal. Preserve original delivered-coal feedstock quantities, every regional electricity and heat input, infrastructure, water, 72 direct biosphere exchanges and local parameters. Do not substitute carbon black, carbon fibre or mercury-bearing waste disposal. Preserve kg of hard-coal feedstock using complete native delivered regional-storage supply, not mine-only coal or an energy-normalized coal-combustion service. Original country input rows and source coal quantities remain separate. ID uses AU, CN uses CPA, RNA uses US, and RoW uses the complete UCTE storage mix as explicit geographic/feedstock proxies. Grade, carbon/ash/moisture content, mining, allocation, delivery, vintage and internal uncertainty differ; no LHV, carbon-content, moisture or yield multiplier is established. Retain separately modeled source combustion emissions without adding another combustion stage. Preserve each negative ash demand as a positive reviewed treatment-service demand using factor -1. Six biosphere labels per inventory are canonical publisher renames with unchanged UUID, compartment and unit, not substance or ionic-mass proxies. No original emission, nonempty input or parameter is omitted, aggregated, renormalized or replaced by a theoretical carbon/water balance. Native utility/geography/technology differences and original inventory limitations remain explicit.

limitations: One positive kg of reactivated granular carbon, despite the source treatment name; do not flip the product reference. Preserve its actual reactivation energy, infrastructure, water, 72 direct biosphere exchanges, parameters and positive spent-carbon stock demand. The existing reviewed spent-carbon market retains its positive-reference cut-off stock allocation and complete freight; that stock is not mercury-waste disposal and does not make reactivation burden-free. Preserve kg of hard-coal feedstock using complete native delivered regional-storage supply, not mine-only coal or an energy-normalized coal-combustion service. Original country input rows and source coal quantities remain separate. ID uses AU, CN uses CPA, RNA uses US, and RoW uses the complete UCTE storage mix as explicit geographic/feedstock proxies. Grade, carbon/ash/moisture content, mining, allocation, delivery, vintage and internal uncertainty differ; no LHV, carbon-content, moisture or yield multiplier is established. Retain separately modeled source combustion emissions without adding another combustion stage. Preserve each negative ash demand as a positive reviewed treatment-service demand using factor -1. Six biosphere labels per inventory are canonical publisher renames with unchanged UUID, compartment and unit, not substance or ionic-mass proxies. No original emission, nonempty input or parameter is omitted, aggregated, renormalized or replaced by a theoretical carbon/water balance. Native utility/geography/technology differences and original inventory limitations remain explicit.

Only the individually inspected ecoinvent 3.9 cut-off identities qualify. Native utilities, coal grades, delivery, transport fleets, geography, technology, allocation, vintage, internal uncertainty and biosphere coverage are screening approximations with unquantified score effects. Preserve original production/reactivation shares, all nonempty process inputs, signed caller quantities, uncertainty, formulas, direct emissions and freight; no renormalization or recovered-material/energy credit. Exactly 51 proven empty negative-reference cut-off ash receivers are omitted from the two ash helper inventories with identity/quantity/hash audits; no nonempty receiving inventory is omitted. Source emptiness does not authorize zero-burden substitutes elsewhere. Other versions and consequential conversions are not newly approved.

limitations: One positive kg of reactivated granular carbon, despite the source treatment name; do not flip the product reference. Preserve its actual reactivation energy, infrastructure, water, 72 direct biosphere exchanges, parameters and positive spent-carbon stock demand. The existing reviewed spent-carbon market retains its positive-reference cut-off stock allocation and complete freight; that stock is not mercury-waste disposal and does not make reactivation burden-free. Preserve kg of hard-coal feedstock using complete native delivered regional-storage supply, not mine-only coal or an energy-normalized coal-combustion service. Original country input rows and source coal quantities remain separate. ID uses AU, CN uses CPA, RNA uses US, and RoW uses the complete UCTE storage mix as explicit geographic/feedstock proxies. Grade, carbon/ash/moisture content, mining, allocation, delivery, vintage and internal uncertainty differ; no LHV, carbon-content, moisture or yield multiplier is established. Retain separately modeled source combustion emissions without adding another combustion stage. Preserve each negative ash demand as a positive reviewed treatment-service demand using factor -1. Six biosphere labels per inventory are canonical publisher renames with unchanged UUID, compartment and unit, not substance or ionic-mass proxies. No original emission, nonempty input or parameter is omitted, aggregated, renormalized or replaced by a theoretical carbon/water balance. Native utility/geography/technology differences and original inventory limitations remain explicit.

Only the individually inspected ecoinvent 3.9 cut-off identities qualify. Native utilities, coal grades, delivery, transport fleets, geography, technology, allocation, vintage, internal uncertainty and biosphere coverage are screening approximations with unquantified score effects. Preserve original production/reactivation shares, all nonempty process inputs, signed caller quantities, uncertainty, formulas, direct emissions and freight; no renormalization or recovered-material/energy credit. Exactly 51 proven empty negative-reference cut-off ash receivers are omitted from the two ash helper inventories with identity/quantity/hash audits; no nonempty receiving inventory is omitted. Source emptiness does not authorize zero-burden substitutes elsewhere. Other versions and consequential conversions are not newly approved.

source.name: market for compost

inspection.basis: Only exact inspected ecoinvent 3.8 cut-off profiles qualify. All six source compost co-products have positive one-kg fresh-compost references and exactly 44 deterministic zero biosphere rows in total (amount=loc=0, uncertainty type 0, no nonzero dispersion, bounds or formula). Source consumer properties and separately listed application, treatment and emissions remain unchanged. Original literal zero background records are represented by a structurally empty allocated-stock helper, not copied raw inventories. Retain six original producer-share entries and both final-delivery freight rows separately with exact signed quantities, uncertainty and source order, without aggregation or renormalization. Native European rail and generic lorry fleets are geographic/technology screening proxies at original tonne-km. This is not proof of real compost being impact-free; score differences from freight, biosphere conventions and source boundaries remain unquantified. No other profile, waste-treatment reference or nonzero stock is approved.

inspection.basis: Exact inspected ecoinvent 3.8 cut-off only. Preserve one kg of source CaCO3-equivalent soil-pH-raising function and signed caller quantity, uncertainty, formulas and properties. Do not infer CaO, Ca(OH)2, purity, nutrient, moisture or molecular-mass factors from legacy lime names. The actual lime supplier inventories mill uncalcined limestone. Retain the global market material shares and all four freight rows, the original RER/RoW lime split, every RER lime producer/freight entry and the previously reviewed RoW lime delivery helper without renormalization. Use complete native milled limestone, the matching native algal-lime regional-storage process and the separately reviewed allocated zinc-mining co-product burden, with quarry, energy, infrastructure, ore, allocation, geography, vintage and internal-uncertainty limitations. All three recovered sludge-derived pH products have positive one-kg references and 75 nominal-zero deterministic biosphere rows in total; paired negative-one-kg waste-treatment branches are nonempty. limitations: Exact inspected ecoinvent 3.8 cut-off packaging service per kg PACKED PRODUCT, not per kg plastic or battery enclosure. Preserve original HDPE and forming quantities, eight signed waste-market entries per factory, all country/climate/fate shares, all waste collection freight and all three delivery freight entries per market. Never scale delivery freight by the small packaging-plastic mass or invent shipment-boundary equivalence.

Open burning and five separate open-dump climates use independent public Doka 2017 calculations calibrated against every inspected nonzero mean and marginal lognormal statistic. Keep negative-infiltration upward-leachate/evaporite behavior. Retain exact canonical units and receiving compartments; the existing same-CAS Nickel-ion to Nickel-II synonym is not a new chemical proxy. No uncontrolled fate becomes incineration, controlled landfill or an empty handover.

Five unsanitary-landfill climates reuse their existing exact 3.8 complete-source helper recipes and native operating-service approximations, unchanged and content-bound. Their machinery, geographic, vintage and background limitations remain. Municipal incineration and sanitary landfill use the complete named native CH PE/PP incinerator and 0.4%-water PE landfill at one signed kg. Source moisture, trace composition, emissions, allocation and geography can differ. The native incinerator does not reproduce source fly-ash extraction/recovered-metal boundaries; retain that as a screening technology difference and add no separate recovery or avoided-energy credit. Score effects remain unquantified.

Complete native RER stretch-blow and injection-moulding auxiliaries/energy services exclude the main polymer input, which is retained separately as HDPE. Source and native process bases both correspond to 0.978 kg stretch-blown or 0.994 kg injection-moulded output per process kg; factor one preserves the processing-input basis, without a new yield multiplier. Native auxiliaries, allocation, internal uncertainty, delivery mix, geography and vintage replace the source services as screening proxies.

Road, rail and container-ship freight keep their original separate quantities, units, signs and marginal uncertainty. Use the same complete native RER fleet-average lorry/RER rail/OCE container-ship services already reviewed for the 3.8 HDPE market. Country fleet, energy, technology, service-versus-delivery, vintage and allocation differences remain explicit; no freight mode is swapped or multiplied by packaging mass.

HDPE reuses the existing exact 3.8 market helper including both virgin shares, three freight entries and exactly four previously approved tiny recycled-supply omissions, without renormalization. This composition authorizes no additional physical omission. All source and native inventories remain unchanged; no inverse, consequential route or uninspected-release qualification is inferred.

Six source delivery-freight formulas contain only constant arithmetic, no free symbols or activity parameters. Independently emitted constant formulas preserve their evaluated quantities; original expression hashes retain traceability without publishing raw licensed formula strings. Caller formulas and supported marginal uncertainty remain preserved. No dependence on a source parameter is removed.

limitations: Exact3.9cutoff solution-state chemical market screening reconstructions for hydrogen peroxide50%, sodium hypochlorite15% and industrial phosphoric acid85%, per signedkg active chemical. The ecoinvent2013methodology section9.3 identifies active-substance quantity conventions and explains the older v1/v2solution naming; percentages describe supplied concentration rather than an automatic mixture-quantity multiplier. Source positive1kg without-water references have1kg dry active mass. Original native archive references retain the legacy names, positive1kg references and matching chemical identities. Native active-mass phosphoric/caustic conventions were independently inspected in the earlier active-chemical review; equal hydrogen0.0656kg and phosphoric-feed1.02kg/sulphuric-acid0.129kg inputs corroborate the peroxide/phosphoric nominal basis. Apply factor+1, not1/0.50,1/0.15or1/0.85. Keep every original producer share, freight row, signedquantity and supported uncertainty separately, without renormalization; native plants include upstream precursor transport and only original final-product market freight is added. Complete native RER production replaces source regional producer inventories. The hypochlorite correspondence is explicitly a supply-boundary/reagent screening proxy: both descriptions refer to chlorine-emission capture, but source producers record0.952447874110337kg primary chlorine and1.07441948482084kg active NaOH perkg; native records no primary chlorine input and0.56kg active NaOH. Native chemical-plant heat/electricity, allocation, emissions and internal uncertainty also differ. Do not rescale the reference quantity to force a reagent match, invent primary-chlorine/caustic compensation, or introduce an avoided-emission credit. Missing native primary-chlorine burdens can affect scores and the effect is unquantified. Complete RER rail/barge/heavy-lorry and OCE container-shipping services retain originaltonne-km; country/traction/fleet/load/technology, geography, allocation, grade, vintage, biosphere exclusions and internal uncertainty differ. No extra water, density, loss, purity, carbon or concentration multiplier is introduced. Separate caller emissions and carbon-resource exchanges remain unchanged. Only exact independently inspected3.9cutoff is newly approved. The older3.8phosphoric target and factor remain unchanged; its positive active basis is made explicit without changing its delivered data. No new physical source-exchange omission or other-version/consequential/reverse approval is introduced. This batch does not complete pulp heat or steel transformation/export.
